payload.title: The access vocabulary has no single owner: the role hierarchy is hand-copied into the web as matching backend, the admin bypass and capability check are re-implemented in shared-ui, the capability catalogue is private to auth-service, and the only module-access rule exists in the web client
evidence: web/shared-ui/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx:210-220 (web copy of the hierarchy labelled matching backend)
web/shared-ui/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx:222-232 (module access decided only in the web, TENANT_ADMIN always true)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/permission-catalogue.ts:20-134 (catalogue literal no other workspace can import)
web/shared-ui/src/types/index.ts:18 (one of three web UserRole unions, beside AuthContext.tsx:37 and tenant-admin lib/types.ts:20)
payload.rule_violated: Plan section 2 and PKG-02: one pure decideAccess shared by guards, NATS, sockets and the nav, in which the global role never grants module access; repo single-source-of-truth rule
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-02, release R1.
